zh_TW: 世界還沒有真正的太陽
en: The World Before the True Sun

zh_TW:
最初，一切都靜悄悄的。只有空空的天空，只有平靜的海。
造物者主宰與綠咬鵑之蛇，在水中發著光。天心烏拉坎從天上來，和他們一起商量、一起思索。他們說：「大地。」大地就像雲、像霧一樣出現了。
可是，黎明還沒有來。天地間只有微微的光；萬物看得見，卻沒有一樣東西有影子。真正的太陽，還沒有升起。
en:
In the beginning, all was silent and still. There was only the empty sky, only the calm sea.
The makers, Sovereign and Quetzal Serpent, glowed in the water. Heart of Sky, Huracan, came down from above. They talked together; they thought together. They said, “Earth,” and the earth rose up like a cloud, like a mist.
But the dawn had not yet come. Only a faint light lay over sky and earth. Everything could be seen, yet nothing cast a shadow. The true sun had not yet risen.

zh_TW: 大地
en: The Earth

zh_TW:
大地上有了山，有了森林，也有了人家。
森林邊有一間屋子，住著一家人。離屋子不遠，有一座球場；球場旁的那條路，一直往下通到地底。
大地在上，地底在下。這個故事，就發生在兩者之間。
en:
Now the earth had mountains, it had forests, and it had homes.
At the edge of a forest stood a house where a family lived. Not far from the house was a ballcourt, and beside the ballcourt a road ran down, down, deep beneath the earth.
The earth lay above; the underworld lay below. This story happened between the two.

zh_TW: 地底的西巴爾巴
en: Xibalba Below

zh_TW:
大地底下，是西巴爾巴——「恐懼之地」。
那裡住著西巴爾巴的諸王。為首的是一死神與七死神。其他的王，各掌一種病痛：有的讓人的血生病，有的讓人腫脹，有的讓人瘦成骨頭，有的讓人倒在路上。
他們坐在地底的黑暗裡，最在意的，就是別人敬不敬重他們。
en:
Beneath the earth lay Xibalba, the Place of Fear.
There lived the lords of Xibalba. At their head were One Death and Seven Death. Each of the other lords ruled over a sickness: some made people’s blood sick, some made them swell, some wasted them down to bone, and some struck them down on the road.
They sat in the darkness under the earth, and what they cared about most was whether others showed them respect.

zh_TW: 一胡納普與七胡納普
en: One Hunahpu and Seven Hunahpu

zh_TW:
在黑暗中、在夜裡，祖父與祖母生下了兩個兒子：一胡納普與七胡納普。
哥哥一胡納普娶了妻子；弟弟七胡納普沒有成家，總是陪在哥哥身邊，像哥哥的幫手。
兩兄弟都是了不起的智者，學問很大，在大地上看得又遠又清楚。他們生來就是善良的人。
en:
In the darkness, in the night, Grandfather and Grandmother had two sons: One Hunahpu and Seven Hunahpu.
The elder, One Hunahpu, took a wife. The younger, Seven Hunahpu, never married. He stayed always at One Hunahpu’s side, his brother’s companion and helper.
Both brothers were great sages, full of knowledge, and they could see far and clearly across the face of the earth. They were good by nature, good from birth.

zh_TW: 祖母一家
en: Grandmother’s Family

zh_TW:
一胡納普的妻子名叫斯巴基亞洛。他們有兩個兒子，哥哥叫巴茲，弟弟叫丘文。
兩兄弟把自己的才能都教給了孩子。巴茲與丘文長大後，會吹笛、會唱歌，會寫字、會雕刻，還會琢玉、會打造金銀。
祖母看著孫子長大。只是後來，斯巴基亞洛過世了。
en:
One Hunahpu’s wife was named Xbaquiyalo. They had two sons. The elder was One Batz, and the younger was One Chouen.
The two brothers passed all their gifts on to the boys. One Batz and One Chouen grew up to be flute players and singers, writers and carvers, jade cutters and workers of gold and silver.
Grandmother watched her grandsons grow. But in time, Xbaquiyalo passed away.

zh_TW: 球具與球賽
en: The Gear and the Game

zh_TW:
一胡納普和七胡納普最喜歡的，就是擲骰子和打球，天天都玩。一家四個人分成兩隊，彼此對打。
他們有一整套漂亮的球具：皮護具、護腰、護臂、頭飾、面具，還有一顆橡膠球。
每當他們在球場上打球，就有一隻隼飛來看。牠是天心的使者，一眨眼就能飛回天上。
en:
What One Hunahpu and Seven Hunahpu loved most was throwing dice and playing ball, and they played every day. The four of them split into two teams and played against each other.
They had a fine set of gear: leather pads, a yoke for the hips, arm guards, headdresses, masks, and a rubber ball.
Whenever they played in the ballcourt, a falcon flew down to watch. He was the messenger of Heart of Sky, and in the blink of an eye he could fly back to the sky.

zh_TW: 球聲驚動西巴爾巴
en: The Noise Reaches Xibalba

zh_TW:
那座球場，就在通往西巴爾巴的路上。腳步聲、叫喊聲，一路傳到了地底。
一死神與七死神抬起頭：「地面上在吵什麼？他們在我們頭上又跳又叫，一點也不敬重我們！把他們叫下來打球，打敗他們。」
諸王聚在一起商量。他們也看上了那一整套漂亮的球具。
en:
That ballcourt lay on the road to Xibalba. The pounding of feet and the shouting carried all the way down into the underworld.
One Death and Seven Death looked up. “What is all that noise up on the earth? They jump and shout over our heads and show us no respect at all! Call them down here to play ball, and we will beat them.”
The lords gathered to make their plans. They had their eyes on that fine set of gear, too.

zh_TW: 地面上的球賽（前篇結尾）
en: The Game Above — End of Part One

zh_TW:
地面上，球還在場上彈跳。一胡納普和七胡納普又一次擺好架勢，笑著把球打回去。
他們什麼也沒有察覺。
太陽依然沒有升起，大地依然沒有影子。而在他們腳下，地底的諸王已經想好了主意。
en:
Up on the earth, the ball was still bouncing across the court. One Hunahpu and Seven Hunahpu set themselves once more and, laughing, struck the ball back.
They noticed nothing at all.
The sun had still not risen, and the earth still had no shadows. And far beneath their feet, the lords of the underworld had already settled on a plan.

zh_TW: 貓頭鷹使者的召喚
en: The Owl Messengers’ Summons

zh_TW:
西巴爾巴的諸王派出四位使者：箭鴞、獨腳鴞、金剛鸚鵡鴞、顱鴞。牠們停在球場的牆頭上，傳話說：「諸王要你們下來打球，帶著你們的球具。」
兄弟倆把橡膠球綁在屋頂下，交代巴茲和丘文：「好好吹笛、唱歌、寫字、雕刻，讓家裡溫暖，讓祖母安心。」
祖母哭得很傷心。兄弟倆說：「我們會去，但不會死。別難過。」
en:
The lords of Xibalba sent out four messengers: Arrow Owl, One Leg Owl, Macaw Owl, and Skull Owl. They perched on the wall of the ballcourt and passed on the lords’ words: “Come down and play ball with us, and bring your gear.”
The brothers tied their rubber ball up under the roof and told One Batz and One Chouen, “Keep playing flutes and singing, writing and carving. Keep the house warm, and put Grandmother’s heart at ease.”
Grandmother wept bitterly. The brothers said, “We are going, but we won’t die. Don’t be sad.”

zh_TW: 兄弟倆在球場上對練，是遊戲加的戰鬥教學；藏起球具、空手下行，跟原典一樣。
en: The brothers’ practice match on the ballcourt was added as a combat tutorial. Hiding the gear and going down empty-handed follow the original.

zh_TW: 父輩下行
en: The Fathers’ Descent

zh_TW:
兄弟倆跟著貓頭鷹，沿著陡峭的階梯往下走。
他們穿過顫抖峽谷、低語峽谷；渡過蠍子河，沒有被螫；走過血河，因為沒喝河水，平安過去；又走過膿河。
最後來到一個十字路口：紅路、黑路、白路、黃路。黑路開口說話：「走我這條！我是王的路。」
兄弟倆就在這裡上了當，踏上了黑路。
en:
The brothers followed the owls down a flight of steep steps.
They went through Trembling Canyon and Murmuring Canyon. They crossed Scorpion River and were not stung. They crossed Blood River safely, since they never drank its water. Then they crossed Pus River.
At last they came to a crossroads: a red road, a black road, a white road, and a yellow road. The black road spoke up: “Come my way! I am the road of the lords.”
Right there, the brothers were fooled, and they set off down the black road.

zh_TW: 議事廳的假國王與熱石長凳
en: The False Lords and the Hot Stone Bench

zh_TW:
兄弟倆來到諸王的議事廳。最前面坐著兩位穿戴華麗的王，兄弟倆恭敬地行禮：「早安，一死神。」「早安，七死神。」
那其實是木頭雕成的人偶。諸王哈哈大笑，笑到肚子痛，在地上打滾。
「請坐我們的長凳。」那長凳是一塊滾燙的石頭，兄弟倆一坐下就燙得跳起來。諸王又笑了。
en:
The brothers came to the council place of the lords. In front sat two richly dressed lords, and the brothers bowed politely: “Good morning, One Death.” “Good morning, Seven Death.”
But they were only figures carved from wood. The lords howled with laughter, laughing until their bellies ached and rolling on the ground.
“Have a seat on our bench.” The bench was a burning-hot stone, and the moment the brothers sat down, they leaped up. The lords laughed again.

zh_TW: 議事廳的木頭人偶會動起來，成為敵人；原典中它們只是坐著。
en: The wooden figures in the council place come to life and fight as enemies. In the original, they only sit there.

zh_TW: 黑暗之屋的失敗
en: Failure in the House of Darkness

zh_TW:
諸王讓兄弟倆住進黑暗之屋，屋裡什麼也看不見。使者送來一支點著的火把，和兩根點著的雪茄：「天亮時要原封不動地還回來，不能燒完。」
兄弟倆在黑暗中坐了一夜，火把和雪茄都燒完了。
天亮時，一死神問：「我的火把和雪茄呢？」
「我們用完了。」
「那麼，你們的日子到頭了。」
en:
The lords sent the brothers to spend the night in the House of Darkness, where nothing could be seen. A messenger brought them a lit torch and two lit cigars: “Return them at dawn just as they are. Do not burn them up.”
The brothers sat in the dark all night, and the torch and the cigars burned away.
At dawn, One Death asked, “Where are my torch and my cigars?”
“We used them up.”
“Then your days are over.”

zh_TW: 兒子們若在同樣的地方失敗，遊戲會閃現父輩當年的下場。
en: If the sons fail at the same places, the game flashes back to what happened to their fathers there.

zh_TW: 處刑、頭顱掛在葫蘆樹上
en: Execution, and the Head in the Calabash Tree

zh_TW:
諸王處死了兄弟倆，把他們埋在碾壓球場。一胡納普的頭被砍下，諸王說：「把他的頭放到路邊那棵樹上。」
頭一放上去，那棵從不結果的樹，立刻結滿了圓圓的果實，再也分不出哪一顆是一胡納普的頭。那就是葫蘆樹。
諸王都很驚奇，下令：「誰都不准摘果子，也不准走到樹下。」
en:
The lords put the brothers to death and buried them at Crushing Ballcourt. They cut off One Hunahpu’s head and said, “Put his head in that tree by the road.”
As soon as the head was placed there, the tree, which had never borne fruit, was covered with round fruit. No one could tell which one was One Hunahpu’s head. That was the calabash tree.
Amazed, the lords gave an order: “No one may pick its fruit, and no one may go beneath that tree.”

zh_TW: 伊奇克與葫蘆樹
en: Ixquic and the Calabash Tree

zh_TW:
聚血有個女兒，名叫伊奇克，意思是「血之女」。她聽父親說起那棵樹，便獨自走到樹下。
樹上的頭顱開口了：「你想要的，只是一顆頭顱。伸出你的右手吧。」
她伸出手，頭顱朝她手心吐了一口唾液，手上卻什麼也沒有。
「這是我給你的記號。人死了，他的兒女會延續他。回到地面上去吧。」
就這樣，她懷了胡納普與希巴拉克。
en:
Gathered Blood had a daughter named Ixquic, Lady Blood. When she heard her father tell of the tree, she went to it all alone.
The skull in the tree spoke: “What you want is only a skull. Hold out your right hand.”
She held out her hand, and the skull spat into her palm. Yet when she looked, there was nothing there.
“This is a sign I give you. When a man dies, his sons and daughters carry him on. Go back up to the face of the earth.”
And so Hunahpu and Xbalanque began to grow inside her.

zh_TW: 這段以倒敘演出；伊奇克在樹下得到「聆聽」，之後傳給雙胞胎。原典沒有這個能力。
en: This part is shown as a flashback. Under the tree, Ixquic gains the power to listen and later passes it on to the twins. The original has no such power.

zh_TW: 樹汁代替心臟、逃亡
en: Sap for a Heart, and the Escape

zh_TW:
六個月後，聚血發現女兒懷孕了。伊奇克說：「我沒有認識過任何男人。」諸王不信，命令貓頭鷹使者帶她去獻祭，把她的心臟裝在碗裡帶回來。
伊奇克說服了使者。她割開巴豆樹，紅色的樹汁流進碗裡，凝成一顆圓圓的「心」。
諸王把它放在火上烤，香味讓他們全都彎下身去聞。趁這時，貓頭鷹帶她逃上了地面。她騙過了所有的王。
en:
Six months later, Gathered Blood saw that his daughter was with child. “I have never known any man,” Ixquic said. The lords did not believe her. They ordered the owl messengers to sacrifice her and bring back her heart in a bowl.
But Ixquic won the messengers over. She cut open a croton tree, and its red sap ran into the bowl and hardened into a round “heart.”
The lords set it over the fire, and they all bent down to smell it. Meanwhile, the owls led her up to the earth. She had tricked every lord.

zh_TW: 伊奇克沿著父輩走過的路倒著往上逃，途中還會自衛；原典沒寫她走哪條路。
en: Ixquic escapes upward along the road the fathers had walked down, defending herself on the way. The original never says which way she went.

zh_TW: 雙胞胎出生與少年時期
en: The Twins’ Birth and Boyhood

zh_TW:
伊奇克來到祖母家。祖母起初不肯認她，直到她從只有一根玉米穗的田裡，背回滿滿一網玉米。
雙胞胎出生了。祖母嫌他們吵；哥哥巴茲和丘文嫉妒他們，把他們放在蟻丘和荊棘上，還吃掉他們的飯。雙胞胎都忍了下來。
有一天，他們請哥哥爬上一棵越長越高的樹。哥哥解開腰布當尾巴，變成了猴子，回到森林裡去了。
en:
Ixquic came to Grandmother’s house. At first Grandmother would not accept her, until Ixquic brought back a full net of maize from a field that held only one ear.
The twins were born. Grandmother found them too noisy. Their older brothers, One Batz and One Chouen, were jealous. They laid the twins on an anthill and in thorns, and ate their food. The twins put up with it all.
One day, the twins asked their brothers to climb a tree that kept growing taller. The brothers loosened their loincloths into tails, turned into monkeys, and went off into the forest.

zh_TW: 祖母一開始就溫暖地照顧雙胞胎；原典中，她起初並不疼愛他們。
en: Grandmother cares for the twins warmly from the very start. In the original, she did not love them at first.

zh_TW: 老鼠與球具
en: The Rat and the Ballgame Gear

zh_TW:
雙胞胎去開墾玉米田。斧頭和掘棒自己會砍樹、翻土，他們只管打獵。
可是每天早上，砍掉的樹又長了回來。夜裡守著一看，原來是森林裡的動物。鹿和兔子的尾巴被抓斷了，最後他們用網子抓住一隻老鼠，燒了牠的尾巴。
老鼠說：「你們父親的球具，就掛在家裡的屋頂下。」
雙胞胎讓老鼠咬斷繩子，把球具藏在通往球場的路旁。
en:
The twins went to clear a maize field. Their axe and digging stick chopped and dug all by themselves, while the twins hunted.
But every morning, the felled trees had grown back. Keeping watch at night, they found it was the forest animals. The deer’s and rabbit’s tails broke off in their hands. At last they netted a rat and burned its tail.
The rat said, “Your fathers’ ballgame gear is hanging under the roof of your house.”
The twins had the rat gnaw through the rope, and they hid the gear beside the road to the ballcourt.

zh_TW: 老鼠以交換的方式成為夥伴；原典中雙胞胎先抓住牠、燒了牠的尾巴，牠才說出球具在哪裡。
en: The rat joins as a companion through a trade. In the original, the twins caught it and burned its tail before it told them where the gear was.

zh_TW: 七金剛鸚鵡
en: Seven Macaw

zh_TW:
太陽還沒升起時，有一位七金剛鸚鵡，用金銀寶石誇耀自己：「我就是太陽，我就是月亮。」
雙胞胎用吹箭射中他的下巴。他扯下胡納普的手臂，帶回家掛在火上。
雙胞胎請大白野豬和大白長鼻浣熊——祖父神與祖母神的化身——扮成治牙的人，把他的牙換成白玉米粒，取走眼中的金銀。他失去光彩，死了；胡納普也裝回了手臂。
en:
Before the sun had risen, Seven Macaw boasted of his gold, silver, and jewels: “I am the sun! I am the moon!”
The twins hit him in the jaw with a blowgun. He tore off Hunahpu’s arm, carried it home, and hung it over the fire.
The twins asked Great White Peccary and Great White Coati, the grandfather and grandmother gods in another form, to pose as tooth healers. They swapped his teeth for white maize kernels and took the gold and silver from his eyes. Stripped of his splendor, he died. Hunahpu put his arm back.

zh_TW: 原典把這段講在父輩之前；遊戲把它放在雙胞胎下西巴爾巴之前，改成 Boss 戰。
en: The original tells this story before the fathers’ story. The game sets it just before the twins go down to Xibalba and turns it into a boss fight.

zh_TW: 齊帕克納與四百少年
en: Zipacna and the Four Hundred Boys

zh_TW:
七金剛鸚鵡的大兒子齊帕克納，自稱造山者。四百少年見他獨自扛起大樹，挖了深坑想壓死他。他躲進側洞，剪下頭髮指甲讓螞蟻搬出去。少年們以為他死了，喝酒慶祝，醉倒時被他推倒屋子壓死。據說他們成了天上的昴宿星。
雙胞胎用花和石頭做了大螃蟹，放在山腳的洞裡。齊帕克納仰躺著爬進去抓，大山壓在他胸口，他變成了石頭。
en:
Zipacna, Seven Macaw’s elder son, called himself the mountain maker. Seeing him carry a tree alone, the Four Hundred Boys dug a pit to crush him. He hid in a side tunnel and cut his hair and nails for ants to carry out. Thinking him dead, the boys celebrated drunkenly, and he toppled their house on them all. It is said they became the Pleiades.
The twins made a great crab of flowers and stone in a cave under a mountain. Zipacna crawled in on his back after it; the mountain settled onto his chest, and he turned to stone.

zh_TW: 齊帕克納、卡布拉坎的故事移到雙胞胎往返西巴爾巴的期間，改成 Boss 戰。
en: The stories of Zipacna and Cabracan are moved to the time when the twins travel back and forth to Xibalba, and become boss fights.

zh_TW: 卡布拉坎
en: Cabracan

zh_TW:
小兒子卡布拉坎，自稱毀山者，腳一跺，大山小山都會崩塌。
天心烏拉坎對雙胞胎說：「他也要被打倒。把他引到東方去。」
雙胞胎說東方有座越長越高的山，帶他去推倒。路上他們烤鳥，香味讓卡布拉坎直流口水；他們在一隻鳥的皮上塗了白土給他吃。
吃下後，卡布拉坎手腳沒了力氣，再也推不倒山。雙胞胎把他綁起來，埋進了土裡。
en:
The younger son, Cabracan, called himself the mountain wrecker. One stamp sent mountains great and small tumbling down.
Heart of Sky, Huracan, told the twins, “He must fall too. Lure him to the East.”
The twins told him of an ever-growing mountain in the East and led him off to topple it. On the way, the smell of their roasting birds made Cabracan’s mouth water. They coated one bird’s skin with white earth and fed it to him.
Then his limbs grew weak, and he could wreck mountains no more. The twins tied him up and buried him.

zh_TW: 時序與齊帕克納一樣，移到雙胞胎往返西巴爾巴的期間，改成 Boss 戰。
en: As with Zipacna, the story is moved to the time when the twins travel back and forth to Xibalba, and becomes a boss fight.

zh_TW: 隼的口信、種下玉米、下行
en: The Falcon’s Message, the Maize, and the Descent

zh_TW:
球聲又驚動了西巴爾巴。使者到祖母家說：「七天後來打球。」祖母傷心地哭了。
她托一隻蝨子傳話。蝨子被蟾蜍吞了，蟾蜍被蛇吞了，蛇又被隼吞了。隼飛到球場，雙胞胎射傷牠的眼睛，又用一點橡膠治好，才一層層問出口信。
出發前，兄弟倆在屋子正中央各種下一根玉米：「玉米枯了，就是我們死了；再發芽，就是我們還活著。」
en:
Again the ball’s sound disturbed Xibalba. Messengers told Grandmother: “Come and play ball in seven days.” Grandmother wept with grief.
She sent a louse with the message. A toad swallowed the louse, a snake the toad, and a falcon the snake. At the ballcourt, the twins hurt the falcon’s eye with a blowgun, healed it with a bit of rubber, and drew out the message, creature by creature.
Before leaving, the brothers each planted an ear of maize at the heart of the house: “If the maize dries up, we are dead. If it sprouts again, we are alive.”

zh_TW: 隼會飛來帶路，成為快速移動的棲架；原典中牠是口信接力的最後一棒。
en: The falcon flies in to guide the way, serving as a fast-travel perch. In the original, it is the last link in the chain of messengers.

zh_TW: 議事廳識破
en: Seeing Through the Council

zh_TW:
到了十字路口，雙胞胎派「蚊子」先去，那其實是胡納普膝前的一根毛。
蚊子叮了最前面兩位，沒有反應，那是木頭人偶。接著一個叮過一個，被叮的王喊痛，旁邊的王就叫出他的名字：一死神、七死神、飛痂、聚血、膿魔、黃疸魔、骨杖、顱杖、羽翼、背帶、血牙、血爪。
雙胞胎進了議事廳，一一叫名問好，也不肯坐那塊燙石頭。
en:
At the crossroads, the twins sent a “mosquito” ahead. It was really a hair from Hunahpu’s knee.
The mosquito bit the first two, and they did not react: they were wooden figures. Then it bit one lord after another. Each cried out, and the lord beside him called his name: One Death, Seven Death, Flying Scab, Gathered Blood, Pus Demon, Jaundice Demon, Bone Staff, Skull Staff, Wing, Packstrap, Bloody Teeth, Bloody Claws.
The twins entered the council place, greeted each lord by name, and refused to sit on the hot stone.

zh_TW: 諸王的名字以字卡叫出。識破詭計後僕從湧出圍攻，這場群戰是遊戲加的。
en: The lords’ names appear on title cards. After the trick is seen through, servants swarm out to attack; this battle was added by the game.

zh_TW: 黑暗之屋與刀刃之屋
en: The House of Darkness and Blade House

zh_TW:
在黑暗之屋，雙胞胎把金剛鸚鵡的紅尾羽插在火把上，雪茄頭放螢火蟲，天亮時原封不動還回去。
球賽上，諸王的球一落地就彈出刀刃。雙胞胎作勢要走，諸王只好用他們的球。這場雙胞胎故意輸了，賭注是四碗花。
夜裡在刀刃之屋，他們對刀刃說：「動物的肉才是你們的。」刀刃全都垂了下來。切葉蟻摘來諸王花園的花，裝滿四碗。
en:
In the House of Darkness, the twins put a macaw’s red tail feather on the torch and fireflies on the cigar tips. They returned both untouched at dawn.
At the ballgame, the lords’ ball sprang blades as soon as it landed. The twins made as if to leave, so the lords had to use the twins’ ball. This time the twins lost on purpose. The prize was four bowls of flowers.
That night in Blade House, they told the blades, “Animal flesh is yours.” Every blade lowered. Leaf-cutter ants filled all four bowls with flowers from the lords’ garden.

zh_TW: 刀刃之屋是可選的挑戰；被說服的刀刃會跟著雙胞胎，成為武器。
en: Blade House is an optional challenge. Once persuaded, the blades follow the twins and become their weapon.

zh_TW: 寒冰、美洲豹、火焰三座試煉屋
en: Three Trials: Cold, Jaguars, and Fire

zh_TW:
接下來是寒冰之屋，裡面滿是冰雹。雙胞胎驅散了寒氣，天亮時好好地走了出來。
在美洲豹之屋，他們對美洲豹說：「別吃我們，我們給你們該吃的。」撒下一堆骨頭讓牠們啃。守夜的人聽見啃骨頭的聲音，以為他們被吃掉了。
在火焰之屋，屋裡只有火，他們卻沒有被燒到。
每天早上，西巴爾巴的人都更加洩氣：「這兩個到底是什麼人？」
en:
Next came the House of Cold, full of hail. The twins drove the cold away and walked out safe and sound at dawn.
In Jaguar House, they told the jaguars, “Don’t eat us. We’ll give you what you should eat,” and scattered bones for them to gnaw. Hearing the crunching, the night watchmen thought the twins had been eaten.
The House of Fire was all flames inside, yet they were not burned.
Each morning, Xibalba lost more heart: “Who are these two, really?”

zh_TW: 沒有寒冰之屋；美洲豹之屋、火焰之屋是可選的挑戰，分在不同諸王的區域。
en: There is no House of Cold. Jaguar House and the House of Fire are optional challenges, each in a different lord’s region.

zh_TW: 蝙蝠之屋與斬首
en: Bat House and the Beheading

zh_TW:
最後是蝙蝠之屋。雙胞胎鑽進吹箭筒裡睡，躲開死亡蝙蝠。
快天亮時，希巴拉克問：「胡納普，天亮了嗎？」胡納普探頭去看，死亡蝙蝠飛撲下來，砍下了他的頭。諸王把頭放在球場上方，西巴爾巴歡呼。
希巴拉克召集所有動物。長鼻浣熊滾來一顆南瓜，天心從天上降臨，把它做成胡納普的頭。負鼠四次把天空抹黑，拖住了黎明。
en:
Last came Bat House. The twins slept inside their blowguns, hiding from the death bats.
Just before dawn, Xbalanque asked, “Hunahpu, is it dawn yet?” Hunahpu peeked out, and a death bat swooped down and cut off his head. The lords set the head above the ballcourt, and Xibalba cheered.
Xbalanque called all the animals together. The coati rolled in a squash, and Heart of Sky came down to make it into Hunahpu’s head. Four times the possum darkened the sky, holding back the dawn.

zh_TW: 蝙蝠之屋一夜是場生存戰，還有假的黎明；讓胡納普探頭的，是玩家自己。
en: The night in Bat House is a survival battle with a false dawn, and it is the player who makes Hunahpu peek out.

zh_TW: 頭顱球賽與兔子
en: The Head Ballgame and the Rabbit

zh_TW:
天亮了，球賽又開始。諸王說：「把那顆頭當球打吧！」
希巴拉克事先吩咐一隻兔子，躲在球場盡頭的番茄田裡。他把球打出場外，兔子就跳出來往外蹦，諸王全都追著兔子跑。
趁這時，雙胞胎拿回胡納普真正的頭，把南瓜放到球場上方。
球賽繼續，希巴拉克一球打爆南瓜，種子撒滿球場。諸王這才發現上了當。
en:
At dawn, the game began again. The lords said, “Use that head as the ball!”
Xbalanque had told a rabbit to hide in the tomato patch at the end of the ballcourt. He knocked the ball out of the court, the rabbit hopped away, and all the lords chased after it.
Meanwhile, the twins took back Hunahpu’s real head and set the squash above the ballcourt.
The game went on. With one strike, Xbalanque smashed the squash, scattering its seeds across the court. Only then did the lords see they had been tricked.

zh_TW: 兔子是會以交換加入的戰鬥夥伴；球賽的玩法是遊戲設計的。
en: The rabbit is a battle companion who joins through a trade, and the ballgame rules were designed for the game.

zh_TW: 主動赴死、重生、四段表演
en: Going to Death, Rising Again, and the Four Performances

zh_TW:
雙胞胎早知諸王要燒死他們，便主動走進火坑。他們的骨頭被磨碎撒進河裡，第五天又重生，扮成流浪藝人跳舞。
諸王召他們表演：殺了王的狗再救活；燒了王的房子再復原；殺一個人、取出心臟再救活；最後希巴拉克獻祭了胡納普，又讓他活過來。
一死神、七死神看得入迷：「也對我們這樣做！」雙胞胎獻祭了他們，卻沒讓他們復活。
en:
Knowing the lords meant to burn them, the twins walked into the fire pit of their own will. Their bones were ground and scattered in the river. On the fifth day they rose again and danced as wandering performers.
The lords summoned them to perform. They killed the lord’s dog and brought it back; burned his house and restored it; killed a man, took out his heart, and brought him back. Last, Xbalanque sacrificed Hunahpu and brought him back too.
Spellbound, One Death and Seven Death cried, “Do it to us!” The twins sacrificed them but never brought them back.

zh_TW: 最終戰省略第三段，不是迴避原典，而是不願由玩家親手演出取心，讓獻祭被當成馬雅文化的代表。
en: The final battle leaves out the third act. This is not to hide the original, but so players never act out taking a heart, which could make sacrifice seem to stand for Maya culture.

zh_TW: 告別父親、升天
en: Farewell to Their Father, and the Rise to the Sky

zh_TW:
雙胞胎說出自己和父親的名字。西巴爾巴跪地求饒。雙胞胎說：「從此，你們不再偉大，只能得到巴豆樹汁和真正做了壞事的人。」
家裡，祖母看見玉米枯了又發芽，高興極了。
雙胞胎到碾壓球場向父親告別：「人們會先來敬拜你，你的名字不會被遺忘。」
然後他們升上天空，一個成了太陽，一個成了月亮。四百少年也成了星星。
en:
The twins declared their names and their fathers’ names. All Xibalba knelt and begged for mercy. The twins said, “From now on, you will never be great. You will receive only croton sap and people who have truly done wrong.”
At home, Grandmother saw the maize dry up and sprout again and was overjoyed.
At Crushing Ballcourt, the twins said goodbye to their father: “People will come to honor you first. No one will forget your name.”
Then they rose into the sky. One became the sun; the other, the moon. The Four Hundred Boys became stars as well.

zh_TW: 告別後，玩家操作雙胞胎一路往上到天空；第一道真光照下，世界才出現影子。
en: After the farewell, the player guides the twins all the way up to the sky. When the first true light shines down, shadows appear at last.
